subject.title: [Feature/RFC]: Add eval-backed option discovery to avoid premature convergence in route/strategy answers

question: Should OpenClaw adopt option discovery before confident route, strategy, or choice recommendations as a default behavior invariant across default runtimes?
rationale: The issue is credible and current main lacks the requested contract, but adopting it changes default answer behavior and may affect cost, latency, and runtime prompt scope.

options.title: Accept Eval-First Default Invariant
options.body: Approve a generic QA Lab scenario to define the behavior before any prompt or runtime change.

options.title: Route To Opt-In Research Profile
options.body: Keep the default agent lean and track the behavior as a best-insight or research profile instead.

options.title: Decline This Default Behavior
options.body: Close this issue with a product decision that the current default search and reasoning behavior is sufficient.

recommendation.title: Accept Eval-First Default Invariant
recommendation.body: Approve a generic QA Lab scenario to define the behavior before any prompt or runtime change.
